title: Palindrome Partitioning
summary: Split the string into contiguous nonempty pieces so each piece is a palindrome.

contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct result once. Outer order is free and the row's internal string order is significant.

statement: Split the string into contiguous nonempty pieces so each piece is a palindrome. Return all such partitions. Preserve the left-to-right order of pieces within each partition. The outer list may be reordered.

examples.explanation: Either keep the whole palindrome or split into single letters.
The first two letters can be combined.
Only the individual letters are palindromes.

hints: Conceptual: A partition can end its first piece at several possible positions.
Directional: Test candidate prefixes for palindromes before recursing on the suffix.
Implementation: Advance to the first unused character after each cut, then undo the choice. Save the pieces when the entire string has been consumed.
complexityAnalysis: O(n·2ⁿ+n²) time including output using a palindrome table, and O(n²) auxiliary space excluding output.
